description: A runtime check the compiler understands, which narrows a type inside the guarded branch.
Narrows primitives. Remember that `typeof null` is `"object"`.
Narrows to class instances by checking the prototype chain. Does not work with interfaces or type aliases.
`'key' in value` narrows object unions by the presence of a property.
`value as T` changes the static type without any runtime check. An escape hatch, not a guard.
